kitDescription: Maiden is an Electric shotgun Burst-III attacker whose kit is built around a 'Revenge' self-status she earns by being attacked 20 times. Skill 1 grants her +26.66% ATK for 20 seconds once Revenge opens, and her burst's second 457.87% hit fires only while Revenge is active — so in real play her burst effectively doubles. Skill 2 taunts all enemies for 10 seconds (which is what pulls fire onto her to feed the Revenge counter) and separately grants her +152.84% Critical Damage for 10 seconds. Her burst's unconditional half deals 457.87% of final ATK to all enemies. In the sim's scope-lock fight the boss never attacks, so Revenge can never be earned and only the unconditional lines — the crit-damage buff and the single burst nuke — actually fire.

skill1.blindSaid: S5: GAP, asserts positively that NO atkPct 26.66 buff fires (and that an always-on proxy WOULD — proving the omission is a choice). S6: implemented as interval:20 approximation under an explicit ⚑ — divergent posture, same mechanics reading.
skill1.formulaCheck: atkPct 26.66 would sit inside the (1+ΣATK%) term if it fired; nothing to route. Trigger cadence is outside the sim's input domain — any encoding manufactures an unmeasured cadence (measured>fudge).
skill1.explanation: Omission is deliberate, recorded verbatim in unmodeled.skill1, and pinned by M3 + S5's zero-buff assertion with a phantom-arm counterfactual proving discrimination. S6's approximated encoding is the weaker posture (fudges a cadence the prose does not give); the driver's faithful omission matches the S2b reconciliation and the landed yulha precedent.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas. The two unconditional lines (S2 self critDamagePct 152.84/10s on the datamined 30s interval; burst 457.87% burstCast nuke, pre-FB, crit-eligible) are FAITHFUL and converged on independently by S2b, S5, and S6 — including byte-identical S6 encodings — and both blind test suites discriminate (permanence/scope/magnitude/cadence counterfactuals on S2; fullBurstEnter and lvl-1-magnitude counterfactuals on the burst). The three out-of-domain lines (S1 Revenge ATK, the Revenge-gated burst rider, the taunt) are DOCUMENTED_GAPs recorded verbatim in unmodeled with a tiered ⚑ recipe, and the omissions are actively pinned: S5's algebraic one-hit-per-cast identity and M2c/M3's phantom-arm counterfactuals prove the shipped override did not silently adopt either the ungated-double or the always-on-Revenge mis-model. The one cross-agent divergence (S6 approximates the Revenge cluster as interval:20 + ungated rider) is a posture question on lines outside the sim's input domain, resolved for the driver's faithful omission by measured>fudge and the landed yulha precedent — S6's own flags concede its cadence is invented. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: (1) the Revenge-omission posture itself — her board number honestly reflects ~half her theoretical burst, so if the owner ever wants the optimistic reading it must come from a measured Revenge-uptime, not S6's assumed 100%; (2) the interval:30 S2 cadence rests on the datamine (kit prose is silent) — a popup-cadence read would firm it; (3) the SG cadence tuple (rof 90 / reloadFrames 142 / 10 pellets) is unmeasured datamine. None of these block GO; all are flagged in the override.
